hypotheses.C0_control_panel_is_balanced: Both corpus splits provide 40 examples in each arbitrary pair orientation.
hypotheses.C1_unrelated_swaps_do_not_use_spelling_a: The spelling rank-1 basis captures less than 25% of unrelated-swap H2 value-delta energy in both splits.
hypotheses.C2_unrelated_axis_does_not_explain_spell: The unrelated-swap rank-1 basis captures less than 25% of held-out spelling value-delta energy.
hypotheses.C3_rank1_axes_are_distinct: Absolute cosine between spelling and unrelated-swap rank-1 axes is below 0.5.
hypotheses.C4_spelling_axis_has_twofold_specificity: The spelling basis explains its held-out spelling panel at least twice as well as either cross-family application.
